facts.fact: Medias24 reports that the Government Council adopted draft law 52.26 (50 articles), which creates a shared medical record for every patient, to be filled by public and private professionals at each act or consultation, with implementing decrees due within 12 months of publication and connection within 24 months of the technical decree; the record is not yet in service and the adoption date is not given, so the report's month is used.
